entities.summary:
Celestino Migliore is an Italian Archbishop of the Catholic Church who serves as the Apostolic Nuncio to France. He previously served as 
Permanent Observer of the Holy See to the United Nations. He has spent most of his career in the diplomatic service of the Holy See.
